archetype: LUXURY & SCIENTIFIC SUSTAINABILITY (Deep Abyss Navy, Coral Accent, Reef Gold & Ivory Paper)
emotional_tone: Cinematic underwater luxury, scientific precision, emotional environmental stewardship. High-contrast editorial look with high-craft interactivity.

headings.style: High-contrast serif headlines, tracking-tight, refined editorial weight (light/regular for luxury titles, semi-bold for key metrics)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight leading-none
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-normal tracking-tight leading-snug

body.style: Clean modern sans-serif, high legibility, tracking-normal or wide for small uppercase metadata

mono.usage: Coral IDs (#RF-02481), scientific coordinates, telemetry badges, QR payload signatures

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x default padding). High breathing room to convey calm environmental elegance.

grid_modes.tetris_hero: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12 items-center

navigation_bar.style: Glassmorphism optical clarity header (z-50). backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#030816]/80 border-b border-white/10 shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300
navigation_bar.elements: REEFORA Crest Logo + Gold Monogram, Nav links (Home, Adopt, How It Works, Impact, Programs, Science, Visit, About), EN/ID Switcher, CTA 'Adopt a Coral' (Coral-Gold Glow Button)
navigation_bar.mobile: Sticky glass header + smooth full-screen modal drawer + bottom quick navigation bar

hero_section.style: Full-screen cinematic underwater coral hero with light rays, floating organic bioluminescent particles, subtle mouse parallax movement, and scroll indicator
hero_section.hero_visual: Strict focus on close-up vibrant Acropora & coral polyp formations (NO fish/turtles as main visual).
taglines: Adopt a Coral. Restore a Reef.

interactive_3d_coral_experience.technology: Three.js Canvas fallback / interactive parametric 3D coral branching mesh with OrbitControls, zoom, node hover highlighting, fragment click inspector showing species data, polyp health, and virtual growth stages (Day 01 to Month 24)
interactive_3d_coral_experience.mobile_strategy: Interactive 3D canvas with optimized touch gestures or interactive high-res 360 viewer

filters: Species (Acropora tenuis, Pocillopora damicornis, Stylophora pistillata, Porites lutea)
Location (Bali Barat, Nusa Penida, Komodo Reef, Raja Ampat)
coral_catalogue.card_structure: Dark abyss cards with 1px border border-teal-500/20, high-res coral close-up image, Coral ID badge (#RF-02481), Status pill ('Available for Adoption'), Species & Coordinates, CTA 'Adopt Coral RF-02481'

multi_step_adoption_wizard.step_2: Customize (Coral Name tag, Dedicated Adopter Name, Personal Message)
multi_step_adoption_wizard.step_4: Simulated QRIS Payment Modal (Interactive Scan & Instant Verification simulation with countdown)
multi_step_adoption_wizard.step_5: Certificate & QR Generation output with download & share buttons

certificate_of_adoption.visual_style: Ivory paper texture (#FAF8F5 background), deep navy typography, intricate gold coral line art borders, reef-gold embossed seal, official REEFORA QR Code linking directly to the live Coral Profile page
certificate_of_adoption.features: Printable, downloadable PDF-style visual display with high resolution canvas preview

my_coral_tracking_dashboard.qr_profile: Public QR Coral Profile viewable directly at /coral/RF-02481 without login

idol_fandom_campaign.tagline: Your Fandom Can Help a Reef Grow.
idol_fandom_campaign.features: Fandom leaderboards (BTS Army Reef, BLINK Coral Haven, Exo Planet Reef), custom fandom certificate badge, idol dedication tags

csr_corporate_page.heading: Turn Your CSR into Something That Grows.
packages: 500 Corals - Dedicated Coral Reef Zone Sponsor
csr_corporate_page.features: Corporate ESG impact dashboard (CO2 equivalent offset, biodiversity index boost, coastal job hours generated), inquiry modal form for custom enterprise partnerships

science_behind_the_reef.visualizations: Recharts dynamic charts showing Coral Survival Rates over time, Sea Surface Temperature vs Growth Density, Substrate Attachment Index, and Species Resiliency Ratings

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='adopt-now-button', data-testid='qris-pay-button').
Do NOT use fish or sea turtles as primary visual heroes; corals and reef substrate must be the absolute star of every hero and card illustration.
Implement the simulated QRIS payment workflow with a realistic QR code canvas, timer, and automatic receipt to Certificate transformation.
Ensure the bilingual EN/ID toggle updates all UI strings, package titles, and certificate text dynamically.
Provide public QR profile accessibility where clicking any Coral ID opens the QR profile view directly without forcing account login.
Keep header backgrounds semi-opaque glass with backdrop-blur-xl to maintain contrast over dark abyss hero visuals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and standard SaaS templates. Use high-contrast editorial serif headers paired with crisp uppercase label tracks.
Layer visual elements with glassmorphism borders (border-white/10), glowing teal shadows, and subtle paper grain for certificates.
Ensure responsiveness on mobile viewports with full bottom drawer navigation for quick access to catalogue, certificate scanner, and tracking.
Use Lucide-react or Phosphor icons exclusively, avoiding AI emoji characters in UI elements.
